title: Python: SenderID field (10-byte extended sender)
description: Implement 10-byte extended SenderID field in Python
close_reason: VERIFIED COMPLETE, no code change needed: Python SenderID (SIID) field support already fully implements draft-lichen-link-01 sections 3.1/3.2/3.4/4.1 and matches the shared v2-wire-format oracle fixed by closed sibling bead l1qw.1.5.4.5 ('Version 2 SenderID' = LLSec bit-7 SI / 8-byte signer-EUI-64 field; the '10-byte' wording in the breakdown doc corresponds to no spec-defined field).
